events.description: Federal Reserve holds again at 3.50-3.75% with three dissents. US 10-year yield reaches 4.71% by month end. Market pricing shifts from cuts toward possible hikes.
Half-year close. US equities near record levels on narrow, technology-led leadership. Non-traded private credit vehicles show continued redemption stress.
US 10-year Treasury yield rises to about 4.46%, near its highest level in more than a year.
Federal Reserve holds the target range at 3.50-3.75% at the first meeting under new Chair Kevin Warsh. Easing timeline pushed out.
Megacap technology complex briefly sheds around USD 2 trillion in market value on AI capital expenditure concerns before recovering later in the month.
events.primary_transmission: US technology, concentrated equity, collateralised lending

events.description: European Central Bank and several other central banks raise policy rates in response to an energy-driven inflation impulse.
Gold prints an intraday all-time high near USD 5,589 per ounce, then begins a multi-month consolidation.
Spot gold trades above USD 5,000 per ounce for the first time.
Gold closes 2025 up roughly 64% for the year after breaching USD 3,000 and USD 4,000 for the first time. Record annual gold ETF inflows of about USD 89bn.
events.primary_transmission: Gold, precious metals miners, inflation hedges
